response_text:
1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than __10000__ Da and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a __divalent__ cation crosslinker.

3) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is __selected from the group consisting of polyethylenimine, polypropyleneimine, and polybutylenimine__.

4) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and __other__ anionic surfactants.

6) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, further comprising __at least one__ monovalent or divalent cation selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium or calcium ions.

10) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS), said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle having a size of less than __2000__ nm.

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a __multivalent cation or anionic surfactant__.

13) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising __at least one of__ Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe or Al.

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer __that can be crosslinked with said composition__; and c) a fluid.

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethylacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, or __N,N-dimethylacrylamide__. 

26) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where fluid is __selected from the group consisting of__ brine or seawater.
